text: Mostly casual clothes — jeans, T-shirts and trainers, because they're comfortable and I walk a lot. For presentations at university or job interviews I'll wear something smarter, like a shirt and a jacket, but I don't feel completely like myself in formal clothes.

tips.en: An everyday style and the times it changes.
tips.kk: Күнделікті стиль және ол өзгеретін жағдайлар.
tips.ru: Повседневный стиль и случаи, когда он меняется.
tips.example: For presentations at university or job interviews I'll wear something smarter

tips.en: The last clause adds how the speaker feels.
tips.kk: Соңғы сөйлем автордың өзін қалай сезінетінін қосады.
tips.ru: Последняя фраза добавляет, как автор себя чувствует.
tips.example: I don't feel completely like myself in formal clothes

questions.followUp: Do you wear different clothes at weekends?
questions.question: What kind of clothes do you usually wear?

text: Not really. I notice trends because they're everywhere on social media, but I don't feel I have to follow them. I'd rather buy a few good-quality things that last for years than keep buying cheap clothes that go out of fashion in a season.

tips.en: The speaker explains a whole approach, not just “no”.
tips.kk: Автор жай «жоқ» демей, өз көзқарасын түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Автор не просто говорит «нет», а объясняет свою философию.
tips.example: I'd rather buy a few good-quality things that last for years

tips.en: Admits noticing trends — the answer is honest.
tips.ru: Признаёт, что тренды замечает, — ответ честный.
tips.example: I notice trends because they're everywhere on social media

questions.followUp: Where do you get ideas about what to wear?
questions.question: Do you follow fashion?

text: In shops, definitely. Sizes vary so much between brands that I really need to try things on. I do buy basics online sometimes, like socks or plain T-shirts, since I know exactly what size I need and there's very little that can go wrong.

tips.en: A concrete reason — sizes differ between brands.
tips.ru: Конкретная причина — размеры у брендов разные.
tips.example: Sizes vary so much between brands

tips.en: I do buy — do for emphasis before an exception.
tips.kk: I do buy — ерекшелік алдында күшейту үшін do.
tips.ru: I do buy — do для усиления перед исключением.
tips.example: I do buy basics online sometimes

questions.followUp: Have you ever had a problem with an online order?
questions.question: Do you prefer buying clothes online or in shops?

text: Yes, we had a dark blue uniform with a white shirt, and on special days we wore a formal version with a tie. At the time I hated it, but looking back, it made mornings much easier and meant nobody was judged for wearing cheaper clothes.

tips.en: What the uniform was like and how the speaker felt.
tips.kk: Форма қандай болды және оған көзқарас қандай болды.
tips.ru: Как выглядела форма и как к ней относился.
tips.example: we had a dark blue uniform with a white shirt

tips.en: Looking back — the opinion has changed, which sounds mature.
tips.kk: Looking back — пікір өзгерген, бұл парасатты естіледі.
tips.ru: Looking back — мнение изменилось, и это звучит зрело.
tips.example: looking back, it made mornings much easier

questions.question: Did you wear a uniform at school?

text: To some extent, yes. Clothes can show whether someone is practical, creative or wants to be noticed. But I think it's easy to make the wrong judgement, because some people simply don't care about fashion, and that tells you nothing about their personality.

tips.en: To some extent gives a precise degree of agreement.
tips.kk: To some extent — келісімнің дәл дәрежесі.
tips.ru: To some extent — точная степень согласия.

tips.en: But introduces a limitation — the answer is balanced.
tips.example: But I think it's easy to make the wrong judgement

questions.followUp: What do your clothes say about you?
questions.question: Do you think clothes say a lot about a person?
